svg.text: A community grows when people help one another.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, cursive

svg.text: Last weekend, our class cleaned the local park.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, cursive

svg.text: We collected litter and planted young trees.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, cursive

svg.text: Working together taught me to listen and share.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, cursive

svg.text: Small acts of service can make a lasting difference.
